create_TransformersFlashCausalLM: create a TransformersFlashCausalLM instance to load a HuggingFace causal LM model with flash attention and KV cache support
build_tgi_flash_attention_forward: build a custom flash attention forward function that stores KV cache and dispatches to paged or prefill attention
register_tgi_attention_function: register the tgi flash attention function into Transformers ALL_ATTENTION_FUNCTIONS to enable tgi attention implementation
run_model_forward: run the monkey-patched model forward pass with KV cache, block tables, and sequence length tracking for generation
configure_replicated_attention_models: configure the REPLICATED_ATTENTION_MODELS list to skip head division for models like olmo2 and phi3
